values.task_boundary: Add the bounded Runtime path and deterministic proof for one governed resident agent initiating work addressed to another admitted resident agent.
deliverables: Distinct identity and correlation model for initiated work
Observatory/Inspector activity proof using authoritative events or a minimal rendering fix if required
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: A focused integration test proves a model-backed Shepherd initiates a turn to a second admitted model-backed agent
AC-2: The emitted event or work item identifies Beacon as sender and Ember as recipient using canonical agent identities
AC-3: The recipient generated result is correlated to the initiated work and cannot be confused with the Shepherd user-facing reply
AC-4: Duplicate or replayed initiation is idempotent or explicitly rejected under a documented rule
AC-5: Cancellation and recipient or provider failure produce truthful terminal state
AC-6: Observatory feed proof shows the agent-to-agent activity, with UI changes only if the existing Activity surface cannot render the authoritative event
AC-7: Exact-head independent review passes before publication
dependencies: Issue #661 Shepherd configured-provider reply work must remain distinct from initiation semantics
Current Runtime resident agent admission and configured-provider execution paths
non_goals: Do not conflate initiation with the separate Shepherd hardcoded-reply defect
Do not implement unrestricted autonomous messaging
Do not implement broadcast or arbitrary fan-out
Do not implement recursive unbounded conversations
Do not restart or modify the live Runtime as part of implementation
Do not claim live provider acceptance without separate authorization
